Customer.description: A CSP customer (response of get-customer-by-id / create-customer).

fields.name: userCredentials
fields.note: only on create: admin userName + password (save it)

fields.name: friendlyName
fields.note: the "nickname" shown in Partner Center; PATCH this field to rename

fields.name: cancellationAllowedUntilDate
fields.note: AUTHORITATIVE deadline for cancelling and for reducing seats. Read it off the subscription; never hardcode a window length - Microsoft has changed it.

fields.name: refundOptions
fields.note: read-only; the refund available if the subscription is cancelled now

fields.name: scheduledNextTermInstructions
fields.note: product { billingCycle, termDuration, quantity } plus customTermEndDate; applied when the next term starts, and only while autoRenewEnabled is true

fields.name: hasPurchasableAddons
fields.note: whether add-ons can be bought against this subscription

fields.name: suspensionReasons
fields.note: read-only; why the subscription was suspended. A Microsoft-set reason cannot be cleared by reactivating.

Order.description: An order placed for a customer (response of get-order-by-id / checkout).

fields.name: invoiceDetails
fields.note: per billing-provider links to line items

CartLineItem.description: A line item in a cart (request of create-cart).

fields.name: termDuration
fields.note: ISO 8601; omit for Azure plan / perpetual software

NewCommerceMigrationSchedule.description: A scheduled legacy-to-NCE migration (response of create/get migration schedule).

fields.name: id
fields.note: schedule id; use it on get, update and cancel

fields.name: currentSubscriptionId
fields.note: the legacy subscription that will be migrated

fields.name: customTermEndDate
fields.note: co-terminate the migrated subscription with an existing end date

fields.name: migrateOnRenewal
fields.note: required unless targetDate is set; run the migration at the legacy term's renewal instead of a fixed date

fields.name: addOnMigrations
fields.note: FLAT list of add-ons, each with its own currentSubscriptionId/quantity/billingCycle/termDuration

Conversion.description: A legacy trial-to-paid conversion offer or its result.

fields.name: offerId
fields.note: the trial offer being converted from

fields.name: targetOfferId
fields.note: the paid offer being converted to

fields.name: quantity
fields.note: defaults to the trial's seat count; set it to buy a different number

SupportContact.description: The partner named as support contact on a subscription.

fields.name: supportTenantId
fields.note: tenant of the partner taking support
